method: Built-in image_gen tool; one image per call, generated sequentially.
product: Fictional unbranded white leather low-top trainer with natural gum rubber sole.
notes: No customer product reference was supplied. Output 01 establishes the fictional trainer used across the set.
All ten are ecommerce reference examples. The outsole tread and other newly revealed surfaces are concept details, not verified specifications of a real product.
Outputs 09 and 10 show an adult wearing a matching pair, cropped below the knees.

outputs.title: Three-Quarter Product
outputs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic premium ecommerce preview photograph, the THREE-QUARTER PRODUCT view for a ten-image footwear set. Establish one fictional unbranded adult RIGHT FOOT low-top trainer: clean white lightly grained leather, rounded toe, plain minimal stitched leather panels, six eyelet pairs and neatly tied white flat laces, padded white collar and a plain white heel tab, pale natural gum-rubber cupsole of moderate thickness. Simple shallow herringbone outsole if a tiny edge is visible. No perforated decorative logo shapes, no stripes, no words, no brand, no numbers, no coloured embellishments. This shoe design must be simple and reproducible across further views. Show a single complete right shoe at a front three-quarter angle, toe toward the lower left and heel toward the upper right, revealing toe, lacing and lateral outer side. Include the whole toe, heel and sole with comfortable margins. Seamless warm off-white/light-grey studio floor and background, soft diffused side lighting, realistic subtle grounding shadow, accurate leather and rubber textures, restrained contemporary catalogue style. Portrait4:5 composition with product centered. No person, feet, socks, hands, shoe box or props. No text, border, watermark or collage. Single photographic image.
